question: Inhibiting mTOR signalling had been shown to induce which cell-cleaning process?

receipt.quote: The initial studies by the laboratories of Oddo and Galvan also showed that rapamycin treatment reduced the accumulation of Aβ aggregates in the brains of their transgenic AD mice [62, 63], which was expected because inhibition of mTOR signaling had been shown to induce autophagy [64].
